input.quote: 21.3 Under no circumstances shall any Party be liable to any other Party in contract, tort, (including negligence or breach of statutory duty) or otherwise for loss (whether direct or indirect) of profits, property, traffic, business or anticipated savings, or for any indirect or consequential loss or damage in connection with the operation of this Agreement howsoever caused.
input.rationale: Paragraph 21 contains only a mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential loss (21.3) and a mutual third-party indemnity limited to each Party's Schedule B share (21.2); Paragraph 4.9 excludes PG-member liability. Searches for any cap, "shall not exceed", gross negligence or wilful misconduct language return nothing, so no aggregate liability cap or carve-out structure exists anywhere in the Agreement. Our direct liability (including to the other APCN 2 Parties as indemnitors) is therefore unlimited in amount, which fails the fallback on its material terms (no mutual cap, no 12-months-fees basis, no carve-outs). We therefore inserted the shortest fallback-level clause as new Subparagraph 21.4: a mutual cap at twelve months' fees with indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct outside the cap. We did not pursue the preferred USD 1,000,000 floor or the additional preferred carve-outs, and we left the existing mutual consequential-loss exclusion in 21.3 untouched.

mappings.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
The cap is based on 12 months of fees.
Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.

proposal.summary: Add a mutual 12-months-fees aggregate liability cap as new Subparagraph 21.4, with indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct outside the cap.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Paragraph 21.3 excludes indirect loss but the Agreement contains no aggregate liability cap, leaving every Party exposed without limit; we added a mutual cap at twelve months' fees. Indemnification obligations, breach of confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct remain uncapped. This is our fallback position.

ops.text: Except in respect of a Party's indemnification obligations under Subparagraph 21.2, its breach of Paragraph 31 (Confidentiality), its gross negligence or its wilful misconduct, each Party's total aggregate liability to the other Parties arising out of or in connection with this Agreement shall not exceed the fees paid or payable by that Party under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the claim.
